Class ClimateEvent

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.model.ClimateEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, SimulationTemporalEvent
public class ClimateEvent extends Object implements Serializable, SimulationTemporalEvent

ClimateEvent

Core operational data model representing a scheduled biophysical cataclysm, climatic shock, sociological intervention, or technological milestone in the simulation calendar.

Fully supports active duration modeling:

  • Permanent events (durationDays <= 0, e.g. technological breakthroughs, institutional reforms): induces irreversible structural state changes in physical capital \(K\), energy grid capacity, or state capacity.
  • Transient cataclysms (durationDays > 0, e.g. volcanic eruptions, earthquakes, pandemics): active over physical time with atmospheric residence e-folding half-lives or SEIR epidemic curves.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

      public boolean isDue(int currentYear, int currentMonth, int currentDay)
      Checks if this event is due based on continuous linear date comparison. Guaranteed to trigger even with coarse discrete time steps (e.g. 7-day or 30-day ticks).
      Specified by:
      isDue in interface SimulationTemporalEvent
      Parameters:
      currentYear - simulation year
      currentMonth - simulation month (0-11 or 1-12)
      currentDay - simulation day of month (1-30/31)
      Returns:
      true if current date reaches or passes the event start date
